meta.strict_mode_note: Default mode reports honestly and exits 0; --strict exits 1 if any gate fails.

gates.name: EEP + IEP-1 foundation
gates.target: EEP and IEP-1 source, Dockerfiles, compose services, and contract tests exist
gates.why: This is the current working spine: validated ingest plus language signal extraction.

gates.name: IEP-2 duplicate/cluster service
gates.target: src/iep2 service, Dockerfile, compose service, and pair-evaluation artifact exist
gates.why: IEP-2 is the highest-ROI next build because it unlocks real incident fusion and T3.

gates.name: IEP-3 calibrated routing and priority
gates.target: src/iep3 service, calibration artifact, threshold sweep, and route test suite exist
gates.why: Calibration is what separates a serious triage system from a rules dashboard.

gates.name: IEP-4 explanation and HITL service
gates.target: Prompts, explanation service, HITL decision contract, and prompt tests exist
gates.why: Prompts are present, but the service and contract tests must make IEP-4 real.

gates.name: MLOps lifecycle and experiment evidence
gates.target: MLflow service, training/eval scripts, model registry artifact, and promotion thresholds exist
gates.why: Rubric M1/M2 require lifecycle evidence, not just model code.

gates.name: Observability
gates.target: Prometheus/Grafana services and low-cardinality ML metric contract exist
gates.why: Monitoring needs ML-specific signals: drift, HITL rate, confidence, false auto-route risk.

gates.name: Public cloud EEP readiness
gates.target: Azure/app deployment config, cloud runbook, and public healthcheck evidence exist
gates.why: GT2 is a hard gate: the EEP must be publicly reachable for grading.

gates.name: Demo evidence package
gates.target: Stress lab, reliability certificate, pair coverage, and final demo script exist
gates.why: The demo must show live input, intermediate AI outputs, metrics, fallback, and MLOps proof.

gates.name: QA breadth
gates.target: >=30 unit/regression tests plus all validators present
gates.why: QA needs to scale with the system as IEP-2/3/4 are added.

recommended_build_order.task: Build IEP-2 dedup/cluster service with pair-evaluation artifact
recommended_build_order.why: Incident fusion is the core CedarFix originality beyond a complaint dashboard.

recommended_build_order.task: Build IEP-3 calibrated routing with threshold sweep and false-auto-route metrics
recommended_build_order.why: Calibration makes the routing decision defensible under professor attack.

recommended_build_order.task: Expand Batch 002 with Arabizi/mixed hard negatives and unrelated negatives
recommended_build_order.why: Better data beats clever architecture with weak validation.

recommended_build_order.task: Add IEP-4 explanation/HITL service with prompt tests and audit output
recommended_build_order.why: This connects AI outputs to human decisions and makes the demo understandable.

recommended_build_order.task: Add MLflow + Prometheus/Grafana with low-cardinality ML signals
recommended_build_order.why: MLOps evidence is 10% of the rubric and strengthens Q&A.

recommended_build_order.task: Prepare cloud deployment and public healthcheck artifact
recommended_build_order.why: Public cloud EEP is a hard gate.
